page.layout: Two parallel columns at the top: Hebrew verse on the left, Latin italic on the right. Below them, centred, the heading ANNOTATIONES. Then one full-width block of annotations with numbered notes 1 and 2 in the left margin and note 3 inline in the text. Running head and page number at the top; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: שאינו עומ' אומר לו איש הר הביה שלום עליך ניכר שהו' ישן חובטו ורשות היה לו לשרוף את כסותו והם אומ' מה קול בעזרי קול בן לוי לוקה וכגדיו נשרפי שישן לו על משמרו רכי אלעזר בן יעקב אומר פעם אחת מצאו את אחי אמ' ישן ושרפו את כסותו ׃ sisteret, his verbis compellabat praefectus, Pax tibi. Si eum dormire animadverteret, baculo percutiebat: eidemque illius comburere vestimenta permissum erat. Hinc illa verba, Quae vox in atrio magno? vox Levitae {3}vapulantis, cujus vestimenta comburū-tur, quod excubiarū + tempore dormierit. Ita refert R. Eleazar filius Iacobi; Semel invenerunt avunculum meum dormientem, ideoque vestimentum ejus combusserunt.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: 1 In Misna pro praefecto est איש vir: verum nota est Hebraeorum distinctio, qua, cum ab הר distinguunt איש, hunc dicunt proprie significare סגדול ובעל מדכר ורשא, magnum rerumque dominum ac caput; quia, ut alia testimonia praeteream, Iud. 7.14. Gideon dicitur איש ישראל vir Israelis, id est, praefectus. Parimodo, ut inquit R. Schemaja, איש הר הבית vir montis templi, est ממונה על כל משמר מסגורים praefectus omnibus custodum excubijs: quamvis male ejus munus ad Atrij custodes restringat, cum haec Misna, ipse praefecturae titulus, alijque Hebraeorum Magistri per totum montem ejus imperiū in custodes extendant.

2 Huic praelucere dicit [?]σχοινίοις תקיקות, quae proprie funalia significant, quod varijs funibus inter se junctis ac colligatis constent: cujus origo פכח a Talmudicis posterioribusque Rabbinis in colligandi significatu passim adhibita est. {3}Antequam progredior, vox לוקה explicanda venit, quae poenam Iudaeis olim usitatam denotat: quam ut pernoscamus, sciendum, Iudaeos praeter quatuor illa ultimi supplicij genera in tractatu Za[?]edrin cap.7. sect.1. descripta, nimirum סקילה lapidationem, שריפה combustionem, הרג occisionem, id est, capitis amputationem

page.notes: Hebrew verse is printed right to left; several letters and vowel-marks in the left column are uncertain and only the clearer lines are given as read. Greek word before "תקיקות" and the Hebrew words פכח, לוקה, סקילה and שריפה are uncertain. The name "Zanedrin" has a damaged letter after "Za". Note 3 is set inline in the text, not in the margin. The "+" after "excubiarū" is printed as shown. "comburū-tur" is a line-end break with a printed mark.
